70 DOGS. NEW HORIZONS. 🐾✈️

On November 16, 70 dogs left El Paso Animal Services by air for rescue partners in northern states—another chance to find loving homes, made possible through Dog Is My CoPilot.

In its November 17 update, the shelter said the partnership had transported more than 450 pets during 2026. This was its final transport flight of the year through that partnership.

Dog Is My CoPilot connects shelters with rescue organizations using volunteer pilots and specially equipped aircraft. The flights are provided at no cost to participating shelters.

That’s a flight plan worth celebrating: aviation helping pets reach new adoption opportunities while opening space for animals still arriving at the shelter.

Cheers to the pilots, shelter teams, fosters and receiving rescues who make these journeys possible. 💛

Source: El Paso Animal Services, November 17, 2026.
